processSmall:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Scans the grid rows for '@' chips and returns true if there exists a boundary (x, y) in the grid such that the four surrounding regions contain the same number of chips." processSmall]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> rchv </REF>: int[] "Two-element int array where rchv[0] is the number of rows and rchv[1] is the number of columns in the scanned grid."
        <REF> caseList </REF>: List<String> "List of row strings; row i is read from caseList.get(i+1), so index 0 is not used."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "Returns true as soon as a boundary with equal counts in all four regions is found; otherwise returns false."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize chipCoords as an empty ArrayList of int[] coordinate pairs, xCoords as an empty ArrayList of Integer, and yCoords as an empty ArrayList of Integer. RESULT chipCoords]
            [COMMAND For each row index i from 0 to rchv[0]-1, read row = caseList.get(i+1). RESULT row]
            [COMMAND For the current row, compute split = row.split("") so that split[j] is the string at column j. RESULT split]
            [COMMAND For each column index j from 0 to rchv[1]-1, if split[j] equals "@", create coords = new int[2], set coords[0] = i, coords[1] = j, add i to xCoords, add j to yCoords, and add coords to chipCoords. RESULT chipCoords]
            [COMMAND For each x from 0 to rchv[0]-1, run an inner loop over each y from 0 to rchv[1]-1; at the start of each (x,y) iteration, set topright, topleft, bottomLeft, and bottomRight to 0. RESULT counters]
            [COMMAND Within the nested x/y loops, for each z from 0 to chipCoords.size()-1, classify chipCoords[z] exactly as in the original code: if chipCoords[z][0] <= x and chipCoords[z][1] <= y increment bottomLeft; if chipCoords[z][0] <= x and chipCoords[z][1] > y increment bottomRight; if chipCoords[z][0] > x and chipCoords[z][1] < y increment topleft; if chipCoords[z][0] > x and chipCoords[z][1] >= y increment topright. RESULT counters]
            [COMMAND After the z loop for the current (x,y), evaluate the short-circuit condition bottomRight == bottomLeft && bottomLeft == topleft && topleft == topright and store whether it is true. RESULT quadrants_equal]
            [COMMAND If the x/y loops complete without the early-return alternative being taken, return false. RESULT false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: quadrants_equal is true for the current (x,y).]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return true immediately from processSmall, skipping all remaining x/y loop iterations. RESULT true]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
